name: @reactunity/monorepo

scripts.//typecheck: Separate from `build` because nothing in the build type checks any more: tsdown transpiles packages/* per file and its dts step does no semantic analysis, and dropping fork-ts-checker means webpack no longer checks the apps either. Unfiltered `-r` on purpose -- it reaches the four react-unity-scripts apps as well as packages/*, and skips members that declare no `typecheck` script. CI runs it beside the build.

//typescript: Everything is on 7 except docs. TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and it changes two things that mattered here: it ships no JS API (its export map points `.` at lib/version.cjs, so `require('typescript')` yields `{ version, versionMajorMinor }` and `resolve.sync('typescript')` fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND), and it *removes* compiler options rather than deprecating them. Both were worked through rather than waited out -- tsdown took over emitting, so no tsconfig needs the removed options, and packages/scripts stopped loading the TypeScript module at all (fork-ts-checker dropped, tsconfig parsed with jsonc-parser, dead verifyTypeScriptSetup deleted), which freed the four apps that build through it. docs is the holdout and says so next to its own pin: @astrojs/check peer-depends on `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0`, and `pnpm check` there runs `astro check`, which needs the API.
